features.title: Ship cli/src static assets in cli/dist
features.user_visible_behavior: asdd ui serves its page from the built CLI and the installed npm package; editing a ui asset marks cli/dist stale.
verification: node cli/bin/asdd.mjs kit build && node cli/bin/asdd.mjs kit build --check
features.evidence: GREEN 2026-11-16 (1a473db): build copies 3 assets to cli/dist/harness/ui; kit build --check fails after an asset edit and passes after revert; asdd ui from dist: / 200 text/html, /ui/app.js 200, /ui/styles.css 200; install.sh OK (packed package contains ui assets; RED before: 'package misses cli/dist/harness/ui/index.html'); npm test 201/201.
